title: Chern Holomorphic Sectional Curvature: Canonical Ampleness, Rigidity, and Flatness Counterexamples
summary: Let $X$ be a compact Brody-hyperbolic complex manifold admitting a strictly positive real $(1,1)$-current $T$ with smooth $dT$ and $dd^cT\le0$. We prove that the canonical bundle $K_X$ of $X$ is nef. If every positive Lelong level set of $T$ has complex dimension at most two, then $K_X$ is ample and $X$ admits a smooth plurinegative Hermitian metric. Strictly negative Chern holomorphic sectional curvature implies Brody hyperbolicity and, when constant, forces the given metric to be Kähler under the latter current hypotheses.
